**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** Broad-scope philosophy journal (metaphilosophy as a field): recent 2025 articles include analytic epistemology/methodology pieces ("Danger Signals for Untrustworthy Thought Experiments," Metaphilosophy 56(2); "What Deep Disagreements Are and Are Not: A Meta-Epistemological Analysis," 56(5)) alongside continental/ethics work ("Responsibility toward the 'Other': A Critical Examination of Levinas's Ethical Philosophy," 56(5)). No single dominant school or method — consistent with stated broad aims.

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** Analytic methodology/epistemology critique, Continental/ethics (e.g. Levinas-style critical exposition), Cross-school comparative analysis (logic vs. ethics/epistemology interrelations), Philosophy-and-other-discipline studies (e.g. AI, linguistics, literature), Sociology of philosophy / teaching-of-philosophy pieces, Book reviews

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **preprint.allowed**: No preprint-policy statement found; Wiley's journal-specific author-guidelines page (onlinelibrary.wiley.com/page/journal/14679973/homepage/forauthors.html) returned HTTP 402 Payment Required on fetch, and general search snippets did not surface a preprint clause.

- **experiential.review_time_months**: SciRev has zero submitted reviews for this journal ('n/a' on all fields). The only numeric review-time figure found (4 months) comes from an undated philosophy-publishing guidebook that appears to describe practices from the 1980s — too old to represent 2024-2026 reality, so left null rather than reported as current fact.
- **experiential.desk_reject_pct**: Same stale-guidebook problem as review_time_months (85% figure is decades old); no current source (SciRev, forums, Reddit) corroborates it.
- **experiential.reviewer_culture**: No first-hand accounts found on SciRev, 小木虫, 知乎, fabiaoji, or Reddit r/AskAcademia — this is a low-volume pure-philosophy journal with essentially no query-time experiential footprint online.
